signature: SUBROUTINE DLAGTM( TRANS, N, NRHS, ALPHA, DL, D, DU, X, LDX, BETA,

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the operation applied to A.

-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, B := $\alpha \, A \, X + \beta \, B$
-   `= 'T'`: Transpose,    B := $\alpha \, A$'\* $X + \beta \, B$
-   `= 'C'`: Conjugate transpose = Transpose

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrices X and B.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: The scalar $\alpha$. `ALPHA` must be 0., 1., or -1.; otherwise, it is assumed to be 0.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (N,1)$.

params.name: beta
params.reference: The scalar $\beta$. `BETA` must be 0., 1., or -1.; otherwise, it is assumed to be 1.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the N by `NRHS` matrix B. On exit, B is overwritten by the matrix expression B := $\alpha \, A \, X + \beta \, B$.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (N,1)$.
